title: PCB DFM checks against fab-house profiles
summary: dfm_check now grades PCB documents against JLCPCB, PCBWay, and generic 2/4-layer fab profiles — min annular ring, drill, trace/space by copper weight, copper-to-edge, soldermask dam/sliver, silk-over-pad, acid traps, and via-in-pad — returning a per-rule pass/fail naming the profile.
